vb3:1.2: paṭhavīdhātu, āpodhātu, tejodhātu, vāyodhātu, ākāsadhātu, viññāṇadhātu.
vb3:2.5: Yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ kakkhaḷaṃ kharigataṃ kakkhaḷattaṃ kakkhaḷabhāvo ajjhattaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ, seyyathīdaṃ:
vb3:2.6: kesā lomā nakhā dantā taco maṃsaṃ nahāru aṭṭhī aṭṭhi miñjā vakkaṃ hadayaṃ yakanaṃ kilomakaṃ pihakaṃ papphāsaṃ antaṃ antaguṇaṃ udariyaṃ karīsaṃ, yaṃ vā pan' aññam pi atthi ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ kakkhaḷaṃ kharigataṃ kakkhaḷattaṃ kakkhaḷabhāvo ajjhattaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ:
vb3:3.2: Yaṃ bāhiraṃ kakkhaḷaṃ kharigataṃ kakkhaḷattaṃ kakkhaḷabhāvo bahiddhā anupādiṇṇaṃ, seyyathīdaṃ:
vb3:3.3: ayo lohaṃ tipu sīsaṃ sajjhu muttā maṇi veḷuriyo saṅkho silā pavāḷaṃ rajataṃ jātarūpaṃ lohitaṅko masāragallaṃ tiṇaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ sakkharā kathalā bhūmi pāsāṇo pabbato; yaṃ vā pan' aññam pi atthi bāhiraṃ kakkhaḷaṃ kharigataṃ kakkhaḷattaṃ kakkhaḷabhāvo bahiddhā anupādiṇṇaṃ:
vb3:3.5: Yā ca ajjhattikā paṭhavīdhātu yā ca bāhirā paṭhavīdhātu, tad-ekajjhaṃ abhisaṃyūhitvā abhisaṅkhipitvā:
vb3:4.5: Yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ āpo āpogataṃ sneho snehagataṃ bandhanattaṃ rūpassa ajjhattaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ, seyyathīdaṃ:
vb3:4.6: pittaṃ semhaṃ pubbo lohitaṃ sedo medo assu vasā kheḷo siṅghāṇikā lasikā muttaṃ, yaṃ vā pan' aññam pi atthi ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ āpo āpogataṃ sneho snehagataṃ bandhanattaṃ rūpassa ajjhattaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ:
vb3:5.2: Yaṃ bāhiraṃ āpo āpogataṃ sneho snehagataṃ bandhanattaṃ rūpassa bahiddhā anupādiṇṇaṃ, seyyathīdaṃ:
vb3:5.3: mūlaraso khandharaso tacaraso pattaraso puppharaso phalaraso khīraṃ dadhi sappi navanītaṃ telaṃ madhu phāṇitaṃ bhummāni vā udakāni antalikkhāni vā, yaṃ vā pan' aññam pi atthi bāhiraṃ āpo āpogataṃ sneho snehagataṃ bandhanattaṃ rūpassa bahiddhā anupādiṇṇaṃ:
vb3:5.5: Yā ca ajjhattikā āpodhātu yā ca bāhirā āpodhātu, tadekajjhaṃ abhisaṃyūhitvā abhisaṅkhipitvā:
vb3:6.5: Yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ tejo tejogataṃ usmā usmāgataṃ usumaṃ usumagataṃ ajjhattaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ, seyyathīdaṃ:
vb3:6.6: yena ca santappati yena ca jīrate yena ca pariḍayhati yena ca asitapītakhāyitasāyitaṃ sammā pariṇāmaṃ gacchati, yaṃ vā pan' aññam pi atthi ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ tejo tejogataṃ usmā usmāgataṃ usumaṃ usumagataṃ ajjhattaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ:
vb3:7.2: Yaṃ bāhiraṃ tejo tejogataṃ usmā usmāgataṃ usumaṃ usumagataṃ bahiddhā anupādiṇṇaṃ, seyyathīdaṃ:
vb3:7.3: kaṭṭhaggi sakalikaggi tiṇaggi gomayaggi thusaggi saṅkāraggi indaggi aggisantāpo suriyasantāpo kaṭṭhasannicayasantāpo tiṇasannicayasantāpo dhaññasannicayasantāpo bhasmāsannicayasantāpo, yaṃ vā pan' aññam pi atthi bāhiraṃ tejo tejogataṃ usmā usmāgataṃ usumaṃ usumagataṃ bahiddhā anupādiṇṇaṃ:
vb3:7.5: Yā ca ajjhattikā tejodhātu yā ca bāhirā tejodhātu, tadekajjhaṃ abhisaṃyūhitvā abhisaṅkhipitvā:
vb3:8.5: Yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ vāyo vāyogataṃ thambhitattaṃ rūpassa ajjhattaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ, seyyathīdaṃ:
vb3:8.6: uddhaṅgamā vātā adhogamā vātā kucchisayā vātā koṭṭhasayā vātā aṅgamaṅgānusārino vātā satthakavātā khurakavātā uppalakavātā assāso passāso, yaṃ vā pan' aññam pi atthi ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ vāyo vāyogataṃ thambhitattaṃ rūpassa ajjhattaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ:
vb3:9.2: Yaṃ bāhiraṃ vāyo vāyogataṃ thambhitattaṃ rūpassa bahiddhā anupādiṇṇaṃ, seyyathīdaṃ:
vb3:9.3: puratthimā vātā pacchimā vātā uttarā vātā dakkhiṇā vātā sarajā vātā arajā vātā sītā vātā uṇhā vātā parittā vātā adhimattā vātā kāḷā vātā verambhavātā pakkhavātā supaṇṇavātā tālavaṇṭavātā vidhūpanavātā; yaṃ vā pan' aññam pi atthi bāhiraṃ vāyo vāyogataṃ thambhitattaṃ rūpassa bahiddhā anupādiṇṇaṃ:
vb3:9.5: Yā ca ajjhattikā vāyodhātu yā ca bāhirā vāyodhātu, tad-ekajjhaṃ abhisaṃyūhitvā abhisaṅkhipitvā:
vb3:10.5: Yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ ākāso ākāsagataṃ aghaṃ aghagataṃ vivaro vivaragataṃ asamphuṭṭhaṃ maṃsalohitehi ajjhattaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ, seyyathīdaṃ:--
vb3:10.6: Kaṇṇacchiddaṃ nāsacchiddaṃ mukhadvāraṃ, yena ca asitapītakhāyitasāyitaṃ ajjhoharati, yattha ca asitapītakhāyitasāyitaṃ santiṭṭhati, yena ca asitapītakhāyitasāyitaṃ adhobhāgaṃ nikkhamati, yaṃ vā pan' aññam pi atthi ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ ākāso ākāsagataṃ aghaṃ aghagataṃ vivaro vivaragataṃ asamphuṭṭhaṃ maṃsalohitehi ajjhattaṃ upādiṇṇaṃ:
vb3:11.2: Yaṃ bāhiraṃ ākāso ākāsagataṃ aghaṃ aghagataṃ vivaro vivaragataṃ asamphuṭṭhaṃ catūhi mahābhūtehi bahiddhā anupādiṇṇaṃ:
vb3:11.4: Yā ca ajjhattikā ākāsadhātu yā ca bāhirā ākāsadhātu, tad-ekajjhaṃ abhisaṃyūhitvā abhisaṅkhipitvā:
vb3:12.2: Cakkhuviññāṇadhātu sotaviññāṇadhātu ghānaviññāṇadhātu jivhāviññāṇadhātu kāyaviññāṇadhātu manoviññāṇadhātu:
vb3:14.2: sukhadhātu, dukkhadhātu, somanassadhātu, domanassadhātu, upekhādhātu avijjādhātu.
vb3:15.2: Yaṃ kāyikaṃ sātaṃ kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ kāyasamphassajaṃ sātaṃ sukhaṃ vedayitaṃ kāyasamphassajā sātā sukhā vedanā:
vb3:16.2: Yaṃ kāyikaṃ asātaṃ kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ kāyasamphassajaṃ asātaṃ dukkhaṃ vedayitaṃ kāyasamphassajā asātā dukkhā vedanā:
vb3:17.2: Yaṃ cetasikaṃ sātaṃ cetasikaṃ sukhaṃ cetosamphassajaṃ sātaṃ sukhaṃ vedayitaṃ cetosamphassajā sātā sukhā vedanā:
vb3:18.2: Yaṃ cetasikaṃ asātaṃ cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ cetosamphassajaṃ asātaṃ dukkhaṃ vedayitaṃ cetosamphassajā asātā dukkhā vedanā:
vb3:19.2: Yaṃ cetasikaṃ neva sātaṃ nāsātaṃ cetosamphassajaṃ adukkhamasukhaṃ vedayitaṃ cetosamphassajā adukkhamasukhā vedanā:
vb3:20.2: Yaṃ aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ anabhisamayo ananubodho asambodho appaṭivedho asaṅgāhanā apariyogāhanā asamapekkhanā apaccavekkhanā apaccakkhakammaṃ dummejjhaṃ balyaṃ asampajaññaṃ moho pamoho sammoho avijjā avijjogho avijjāyogo avijjānusayo avijjāpariyuṭṭhānaṃ avijjālaṅgī, moho akusalamūlaṃ:
vb3:22.2: kāmadhātu, vyāpādadhātu, vihiṃsādhātu, nekkhammadhātu, avyāpādadhātu, avihiṃsādhātu.
vb3:23.2: Kāmapaṭisaṃyutto takko vitakko saṅkappo appanā vyappanā cetaso abhiniropanā micchāsaṅkappo:
vb3:23.4: Heṭṭhato avīcinirayaṃ pariyantaṃ karitvā uparito paranimmitavasavattideve anto karitvā yaṃ etasmiṃ antare etth' āvacarā ettha pariyāpannā khandha-dhātu-āyatanā, rūpaṃ vedanā saññā saṅkhārā viññāṇaṃ:
vb3:24.4: Dasasu vā āghātavatthūsu cittassa āghāto pāṭighāto paṭighaṃ paṭivirodho kopo pakopo sampakopo doso padoso sampadoso cittassa vyāpatti manopadoso kodho kujjhanā kujjhitattaṃ doso dussanā dussitattaṃ vyāpatti vyāpajjanā vyāpajjitattaṃ virodho paṭivirodho caṇḍikkaṃ asuropo anattamanatā cittassa:
vb3:25.4: Idh' ekacco pāṇinā vā leḍḍunā vā daṇḍena vā satthena vā rajjuyā vā aññataraññatarena satte viheṭheti, yā evarūpā heṭhanā viheṭhanā hiṃsanā vihiṃsanā rosanā virosanā parūpaghāto:
vb3:27.4: Yā sattesu metti mettāyanā mettāyitattaṃ mettā cetovimutti:
vb3:28.2: Avihiṃsāpaṭisaṃyutto takko vitakko saṅkappo appanā vyappanā cetaso abhiniropanā sammāsaṅkappo:
vb3:28.4: Yā sattesu karuṇā karuṇāyanā karuṇāyitattaṃ karuṇā cetovimutti:
vb3:30.1: Iti imāni tīṇi chakkāni tad-ekajjhaṃ abhisaṃyūhitvā abhisaṅkhipitvā aṭṭhārasadhātuyo honti.
vb3:32.2: cakkhudhātu rūpadhātu cakkhuviññāṇadhātu sotadhātu saddadhātu sotaviññāṇadhātu ghānadhātu gandhadhātu ghānaviññāṇadhātu jivhādhātu rasadhātu jivhāviññāṇadhātu kāyadhātu phoṭṭhabbadhātu kāyaviññāṇadhātu manodhātu dhammadhātu manoviññāṇadhātu.

vb3:36.2: Yaṃ sotaṃ catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya pasādo . . . pe . . . suñño gāmo p' eso:
vb3:37.2: Yo saddo catunnaṃ mahābhūtanaṃ upādāya anidassano sappaṭigho . . . pe . . . saddadhātu p' esā:
vb3:38.2: Sotañ ca paṭicca sadde ca uppajjati cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ hadayaṃ paṇḍaraṃ mano manāyatanaṃ manindriyaṃ viññāṇaṃ viññāṇakkhandho tajjā sotaviññāṇadhātu:
vb3:39.2: Yaṃ ghānaṃ catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya pasādo . . . pe . . . suñño gāmo p' eso:
vb3:40.2: Yo gandho catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya anidassano sappaṭigho . . . pe . . . gandhadhātu p' esā:
vb3:41.2: Ghānañ ca paṭicca gandhe ca uppajjati cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ hadayaṃ paṇḍaraṃ mano manāyatanaṃ manindriyaṃ viññāṇaṃ viññāṇakkhandho tajjā ghānaviññāṇadhātu:
vb3:42.2: Yā jivhā catunnaṃ mahābhūtāmaṃ upādāya pasādo . . . pe . . . suñño gāmo p' eso:
vb3:43.2: Yo raso catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya anidassano sappaṭigho . . . pe . . . rasadhātu p' esā:
vb3:44.2: Jivhañ ca paṭicca rase ca uppajjati cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ hadayaṃ paṇḍaraṃ mano manāyatanaṃ manindriyaṃ viññāṇaṃ viññāṇakkhandho tajjā jivhāviññāṇadhātu :
vb3:45.2: Yo kāyo catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya pasādo . . . pe . . . suñño gāmo p' eso:
vb3:47.2: Kāyañ ca paṭicca phoṭṭhabbe ca uppajjati cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ hadayaṃ paṇḍaraṃ mano manāyatanaṃ manindriyaṃ viññāṇaṃ viññāṇakkhandho tajjā kāyaviññāṇadhātu:
vb3:48.2: Cakkhuviññāṇadhātuyā uppajjitvā niruddhasamanantarā uppajjati cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ hadayaṃ paṇḍaraṃ mano manāyatanaṃ manindriyaṃ viññāṇaṃ viññāṇakkhandho tajjā manodhātu;
vb3:48.6: kāyaviññāṇadhātuyā uppajjitvā niruddhasamanantarā uppajjati cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ hadayaṃ paṇḍaraṃ mano manāyatanaṃ manindriyaṃ viññāṇaṃ viññāṇakhandho tajjā manodhātu; sabbadhammesu vā pana paṭhamasamannāhāro:
vb3:49.2: Vedanākkhandho saññākkhandho saṅkhārakkhandho, yañ ca rūpaṃ anidassanaṃ appaṭighaṃ dhammāyatanapariyāpannaṃ asaṅkhatā ca dhātu.

vb3:53.3: idaṃ vuccati rūpaṃ anidassanaṃ appaṭighaṃ dhammāyatanapariyāpannaṃ,
vb3:55.2: Cakkhuviññāṇadhātuyā uppajjitvā niruddhasamanantarā uppajjati manodhātu, manodhātuyā pi uppajjitvā niruddhasamanantarā uppajjati cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ . . . pe . . . tajjā manoviññāṇadhātu;
vb3:55.6: kāyaviññāṇadhātuyā uppajjitvā niruddhassamanantarā uppajjati manodhātu, manodhātuyā pi uppajjitvā niruddhasamanantarā uppajjati cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ . . . pe . . . tajjā manoviññāṇadhātu; manañ ca paṭicca dhamme ca uppajjati cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ hadayaṃ paṇḍaraṃ mano manāyatanaṃ manindriyaṃ viññāṇaṃ viññāṇakkhandho tajjā manoviññāṇadhātu.

vb3:59.2: Dve dhātuyo siyā kusalā siyā akusalā siyā avyākatā.
vb3:60.2: sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā ti pi dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttā ti pi adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā ti pi.
vb3:60.4: Kāyaviññāṇadhātu siyā sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā siyā dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttā.
vb3:60.5: Manoviññāṇadhātu siyā sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā siyā dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttā siyā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā.
vb3:60.6: Dhammadhātu siyā sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā siyā dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttā siyā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā siyā na vattabbā sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā ti pi dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttā ti pi adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā ti pi.

vb3:61.4: Dve dhātuyo siyā vipākā siyā vipākadhammadhammā siyā neva-vipākana- vipākadhammadhammā .
vb3:62.3: Pañca dhātuyo siyā upādiṇṇupādāniyā siyā anupādiṇṇupādāniyā.
vb3:62.4: Dve dhātuyo siyā upādiṇṇupādāniyā siyā anupādiṇṇupādāniyā siyā anupādiṇṇa-anupādāniyā.
vb3:63.2: Dve dhātuyo siyā saṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikā siyā asaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikā siyā asaṅkiliṭṭha-asaṅkilesikā.
vb3:64.3: Manoviññāṇadhātu siyā savitakkasavicārā siyā avitakka-vicāramattā siyā avitakka-avicārā.
vb3:64.4: Dhammadhātu siyā savitakka-savicārā siyā avitakkavicāramattā siyā avitakka-avicārā siyā na vattabbā savitakka-savicārā ti pi avitakka-vicāramattā ti pi avitakkaavicārā ti pi.
vb3:65.2: pītisahagatā ti pi sukhasahagatā ti pi upekhāsahagatā ti pi.
vb3:65.4: Kāyaviññāṇadhātu na pītisahagatā, siyā sukhasahagatā na upekhāsahagatā siyā na vattabbā sukhasahagatā ti.
vb3:65.5: Dve dhātuyo siyā pītisahagatā siyā sukhasahagatā siyā upekhāsahagatā siyā na vattabbā pītisahagatā ti pi sukhasahagatā ti pi upekhāsahagatā ti pi.
vb3:66.1: Soḷasa dhātuyo neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbā.
vb3:66.2: Dve dhātuyo siya dassanena pahātabbā siyā bhāvanāya pahātabbā siyā neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbā.
vb3:67.1: Soḷasa dhātuyo neva dassanena na bhāvanāyā pahātabbahetukā.
vb3:67.2: Dve dhātuyo siyā dassanena pahātabbahetukā siyā bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā siyā neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā.
vb3:68.1: Soḷasa dhātuyo neva ācayagāminiyo na apacayagāminiyo.
vb3:68.2: Dve dhātuyo siyā ācayagāminiyo siyā apacayagāminiyo siyā neva ācayagāminiyo na apacayagāminiyo.
vb3:69.2: Dve dhātuyo siyā sekhā siyā asekhā siyā neva sekhā nāsekhā.
vb3:70.2: Dve dhātuyo siyā parittā siyā mahaggatā siyā appamāṇā.
vb3:71.3: Dve dhātuyo siyā parittārammaṇā siyā mahaggatārammaṇā siyā appamāṇārammaṇā siyā na vattabbā parittārammaṇā ti pi mahaggatārammaṇā ti pi appamāṇārammaṇā ti pi.
vb3:72.2: Dve dhātuyo siyā hīnā siyā majjhimā siyā paṇītā.
vb3:73.2: Dve dhātuyo siyā micchattaniyatā siyā sammattaniyatā siyā aniyatā.
vb3:74.3: maggārammaṇā ti pi maggahetukā ti pi maggādhipatino ti pi.
vb3:74.4: Dve dhātuyo siyā maggārammaṇā siyā maggahetukā siyā maggādhipatino siyā na vattabbā maggārammaṇā ti pi maggahetukā ti pi maggādhipatino ti pi.
vb3:75.1: Dasa dhātuyo siyā uppannā siyā uppādino na vattabbā anuppannā ti.
vb3:75.2: Saddadhātu siyā uppannā siyā anuppannā na vattabbā uppādinīti.
vb3:75.3: Cha dhātuyo siyā uppannā siyā anuppannā siyā uppādiniyo.

Sattaraso dhātuyo no cittasaṃsaṭṭha-samuṭṭhānānuparivattino; dhammadhātu siyā cittasaṃsaṭṭha-samuṭṭhānānuparivattinī siyā no cittasaṃsaṭṭha-samuṭṭhānānuparivattinī. Dvādasa dhātuyo ajjhattikā.
